description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty_Internal_Runtime_TplFunction class, which manages runtime template functions in the Smarty templating engine, including calling, registering, caching, and variable management for template functions.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_TplFunction
classes.description: Class managing runtime template functions, including calling, registering, caching, and variable state management.

methods.name: callTemplateFunction
methods.description: Calls a specified template function, dynamically loading it if necessary, and manages template variable state.

methods.name: registerTplFunctions
methods.description: Registers template functions defined in a template, optionally overriding existing ones, and propagates to parent templates if needed.

methods.name: getTplFunction
methods.description: Retrieves source parameter array for a specific or all template functions.

methods.name: addTplFuncToCache
methods.description: Adds a template function to the cache file for nocache calls by extracting and evaluating its code.

methods.name: saveTemplateVariables
methods.description: Saves current template variables onto a stack for later restoration.

methods.name: restoreTemplateVariables
methods.description: Restores previously saved template variables from the stack into the template object.
